hash_semantics: SHA-256 of the original upstream Git blob
adaptations: Extract existing packed activation, Unary shell, RMSNorm warp/CTA/double-load device kernels and norm/tile helpers; omit TVM/Python host wrappers and Blackwell-only 32-byte variant.
Isolate namespace as hyle::compute::cuda_native::sglang_vendor and SGL_DEVICE as HYLE_SGL_DEVICE.
Packed gate arithmetic is unchanged. Unary uses HYLE ordinary stable-tail/-Inf contract: erfc GELU, stable sigmoid SiLU/GELU-tanh; math adaptation is explicit.
RMSNorm arithmetic, indexing, vector grouping and reduction order retained. HYLE private shim supplies CUDA scalar/packed types, RNE casts, pointer offsets, float warp shuffle sum and disabled PDL.
RMSNorm host binding preserves upstream shape selection and pre-Blackwell launch policy; occupancy/SM count are bound once during preparation; no runtime search.
Remove restrict from Unary input/output fields so exact in-place alias is legal; no change to packed gate alias contract.
Complete MoE gate small/large token kernels retained, including stable sqrt-softplus, biased selection and unbiased normalization. Omit TVM/Python host wrapper; isolate namespace and CUDA warp mask.
Move the small-token expert score load inside the existing expert-ID range check; invalid model data cannot read index -1. Normal input arithmetic, selection and reduction remain unchanged.

Bind only E256/384, top6, F32 logits/bias, no fused shared experts, positive-sum normalization and output scaling. Retain native small/large token threshold and launch policy; model tie selection is not generic stable TopK.

Complete DeepSeek hash routing kernel retained with original stable sqrt-softplus, warp SUM, sum+1e-20 normalization, table order and 128-thread launch. TVM host wrapper omitted; namespace and SGL_DEVICE isolated; PDL/fused shared experts disabled; model scale remains in the consumer.

Hash safety adapter adds vocabulary extent and existing HYLE device-status output. Token bounds are checked before table access; all token-warp lanes reject any selected out-of-range expert before score reads. Failed rows receive zero IDs/weights to prevent uninitialized downstream addressing. Valid-input arithmetic is unchanged; failed outputs are not consumable and no cross-token rollback is promised.

D5-F37 retains the exact original block128 Triton GEMM body. A pinned Triton 3.8.0 offline compiler produces an embedded SM89 cubin; HYLE supplies only CUDA Driver module lifetime, argument binding and native launch. No runtime Python or JIT. Dynamic quantizer source is retained for provenance but is not exposed by this MatMul binding.

configuration.rmsnorm_shapes: 64/128/256; multiples of 256 through 8192; multiples of 512 from 8192 through 16384

qualification: C1-AB implementation candidate; correctness/delivery/full-cost performance qualification tracked by owning card. Existing packed gate evidence remains separate.

fp8_aot.qualification: D5-F37; C++ entry/delivery qualification remains separate
